# How SiriusPoint is Turning Digital Transformation into Underwriting Advantage


-


06/10/26


Digital transformation only matters if it delivers real impact for colleagues, clients, and partners. In a recent conversation with Insurance Business, Nestor Lopez shared how SiriusPoint is building a more unified, tech-enabled model – simplifying workflows, improving data quality, and embedding AI to support underwriting decisions.


The outcome is practical. As Nestor says, it’s about “making it easier to do business with us” with a focus on faster onboarding, higher-quality data, automated bordereaux ingestion and greater transparency across the portfolio.


Read the article in full on the Insurance Business website,[here](https://www.insurancebusinessmag.com/uk/news/technology/how-siriuspoints-nestor-lopez-is-rewiring-reinsurance-for-the-data-and-ai-age-576912.aspx) .


Written by SiriusPoint
